chapter: Fellow musicians and brass band world
title: Playing with Father Al and Morris Adams
summary: Played with Florida Al, Alex Scott and Morris Adams in clubs on Magazine and Jackson Avenue.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I remember we played a job at a private party once with Father Al, and you said that you played with him once. You used to play with Father Al, is that right?

I did. Yeah. Somewhere in Washington or something? Magazine, Jackson Avenue. And then we went to a club on Magazine between six and seven. You surprised why I used to own that club, Beckham. We worked there for it out. Who else played in that group? Florida Al, Alex Scott, Morris Adams. We didn't have no drummer. We didn't use no drummer. We didn't have no drummer at the other club on Jackson Avenue.
I don't remember Morris Adams at all. How long has he been there?

He's been there about a year and a half. But he had to quit playing. He had to quit playing years ago. I used to come and get me on some Sundays, and I'd go back there and work out with him. He just wanted to pull his arms away in order to go back there and sit down and talk and play a couple of numbers with him. But he was a fine childhood friend.
How old were you when he was alive today?
He had been about six to seven. I've been around my place. 67. Yeah, you've been here.

That's funny that I never ran across him, but I guess, see I've only been here 26 years now. 26 years? I guess I've known you since I was 25. Something like that. As soon as I started following the brass bands.
It don't seem like that long, those times. No.
